name: U-Line®  Home Collection 24" 5.1 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Beverage Center with Glass Door
shortDescription: Discover the ultimate beverage storage solution with U-Line's Home 24" Beverage Center, expertly crafted for both indoor and outdoor spaces. With a spacious 5.1 Cu. Ft. capacity, it effortlessly accommodates up to 14 wine bottles or 168 cans. Intuitive electronic touch control allows for precise temperature settings from 34°F to 70°F, ensuring optimal storage conditions for your beverages. Choose from six unique interior lighting colors, ranging from adjustable white to cool tones. A cantilever shelving system allows for adjustability of a glass shelf, a 3-in-1 convertible shelf for glass, wine, or half-and-half configurations, and a full-width retractable glass shelf that accommodates taller items on the shelf below, allowing you to personalize your storage to your needs. Choose the stainless steel glass door model, or opt for a panel-ready glass or solid door, customizable with your panel and hardware, or choose from the accessory door wrap options. Transform any living or entertaining space with a design that complements your vision and adaptability that suits your needs. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*
